rawAnswer: {"findings":[{"kind":"defect","severity":"high","title":"Inaccessible-formatter check inverted for every formatter","detail":"In AnalyzeSymbol the condition changed from !formatter.ExcludeFromSourceGeneratedResolver to formatter.ExcludeFromSourceGeneratedResolver. The requirement does not ask for this, and it has nothing to do with SuppressSourceGeneration. After the change, MsgPack010 and MsgPack013 stop firing for inaccessible formatters that the generated resolver will silently leave out. They now fire for formatters the user deliberately excluded from the generated resolver. This changes diagnostics for types that do not suppress source generation, which breaks N2.
